title: 第23章 真正的天才第24章 庞烈的协助
content_zh:
“哈哈哈，欲加之罪，何患无辞！
照这位独眼龙所说，如果我是那位嫌疑人。
那么，请问，我是如何逃过罗师兄几人的追捕的？
难道这位独眼老兄的实力比罗师兄他们更高？”
楚峰此话一出，众人露出恍然之色。
对啊！
他们可都是真元境的高手。
如果真的是这样，以他的实力是如何逃过他们这些人的追杀的？
如果他真的能够逃过罗师兄等人的追杀，那为何会杀不死夏侯武。
这分明就是前后矛盾的嘛！
“你，你这是在胡搅蛮缠！”
夏侯武气炸了。
这楚峰竟然叫自己独眼龙！
“我胡搅蛮缠？夏侯武，你夺我武脉，将我囚禁在天牢之中，还企图谋害我楚家，我恨不得将你千刀万剐。
如果，我真的是你说的那个人，我既然能够躲过罗师兄等人的追杀，又岂能刺杀不了你？
只是可惜了，我那好好的上品武脉，被你植入体内，白白的下降了一个等级，只有中品级别。”
楚峰摇了摇头，一脸惋惜之色。
而其他人，则是脸色狂变。
上品武脉啊！
他们宗门都几乎没有。

这等顶尖的天赋，竟然就这样白白的浪费掉了。
实在是太可惜了！
“楚峰，难道传闻中的大夏国第一天才就是说的你？！”
秦诗瑶震惊的看着楚峰问道。
她本以为，小小的大夏国，没有见识，瞎传的，却没想到，竟然会是真的。
楚峰点了点头。
其他人，也包括那六位长老，也和秦诗瑶一样，不太相信这个传闻。
但是，他们在检查了夏侯武的武脉之后，确认了此事的真假。
“唉，可惜了！”
六位长老纷纷叹息道。
“这个小子，难怪他十八岁了，修为才这么低！
原来是武脉被夺了。”
苏紫英这才明白，为何楚峰会如此了。
她之所以给楚峰一个外门弟子的名额，就是发现楚峰修为不高，认为他修炼天赋不行。
现在看来，这其中还隐藏着这样曲折的故事。
“楚峰，楚峰，我们的事情还没有完！”
夏侯武看着楚峰，随后悄悄的拿出一枚传讯令，将一道消息传了出去。
“好了，此事就此打住，看来我们要寻找的人，应该已经离开了。”
这时候，一名玄阴教的长老说道。
“吴长老，将通道打开吧！”

吴老鬼点了点头，将破塔收了回去。
“呼，终于瞒过去了。”
楚峰心中松了一口气。
然而，
content_en:
"Hahaha, if you want to incriminate yourself, why bother!
According to the one-eyed man, if I were the suspect.
So, may I ask, how did I escape the pursuit of Senior Brother Luo and others?
Is this one-eyed man more powerful than Senior Brother Luo and the others? "
As soon as Chu Feng said these words, everyone looked surprised.
yes!
They are all masters of the True Element Realm.
If that was really the case, how could he escape being hunted by them with his strength?
If he could really escape the pursuit of Senior Brother Luo and others, then why couldn't he kill Xia Houwu.
This is obviously inconsistent!
"You, you are messing around!"
Xia Houwu was furious.
This Chu Feng actually called himself one-eyed dragon!
"Am I being reckless? Xia Houwu, you took away my martial arts, imprisoned me in a heavenly prison, and attempted to murder my Chu family. I wish I could cut you to pieces."
If I am really the person you said, since I can escape the pursuit of Senior Brother Luo and others, how can I not be able to assassinate you?
It's just a pity that my good high-grade martial arts was implanted into my body by you, and it dropped one level in vain, only to the middle-grade level. "
Chu Feng shook his head, with a look of regret on his face.
The expressions of others changed wildly.
Top-grade martial arts!
There are almost none in their sect.
Such top-notch talents were wasted like this.
What a pity!
"Chu Feng, could it be that the rumored number one genius in Daxia is you?!"
Qin Shiyao looked at Chu Feng in shock and asked.
She originally thought that the small country of Daxia was ignorant and spread rumors, but she never expected that it would be true.
Chu Feng nodded.
Others, including the six elders, just like Qin Shiyao, did not believe this rumor.
However, after checking Xiahou Wu's martial arts veins, they confirmed the truth of the matter.
"Oh, what a pity!"
The six elders sighed one after another.
"This boy, no wonder he is eighteen years old and his cultivation level is so low!
It turned out that the martial arts had been taken away. "
Only then did Su Ziying understand why Chu Feng was like this.
The reason why she gave Chu Feng a place as an outer disciple was because she found that Chu Feng's cultivation level was not high and she thought that his cultivation talent was not good enough.
Now it seems that there is still such a tortuous story hidden in it.
"Chu Feng, Chu Feng, our affairs are not over yet!"
Xia Houwu looked at Chu Feng, then quietly took out a summons and sent out a message.
"Okay, let's stop this matter. It seems that the person we are looking for has left."
At this time, an elder of the Xuanyin Sect said.
"Elder Wu, open the passage!"
Old ghost Wu nodded and took the broken tower back.
"Phew, I finally got over it."
Chu Feng breathed a sigh of relief.
